tara (Docs): FYI opened PR to add a compact 'offline proxy' pattern for Private installs. Covers using an HTTP proxy for bundle upload, a fallback SOCKS tunnel for HSM access, and a tiny curl + node example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4102 — can infra + sec glance?

noah (Eng-Platform): Nice. Two asks: 1) show `sha256sum --check` verification snippet for the bundle, 2) include a short note about preserving ClientCert subject when proxying (we had issues with our LB dropping mTLS identity).

juno (Eng-Infra): Will review. Add a minimal iptables/nftables passthrough rule for proxy host and an example `ssh -N -L` fallback if proxied connectivity fails. Also test note: `curl --proxy http://127.0.0.1:3128 --insecure https://local-bundle:8443/api/bundles` for quick verification.

tara (Docs): Draft snippets pasted below — keeping them non-prod and redacted.

```
# verify checksum
sha256sum offline-bundle.tar.gz > offline-bundle.sha256
sha256sum --check offline-bundle.sha256

# Node example (upload via HTTP proxy)
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
await fetch('http://10.10.0.5:8443/api/bundles', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer <TOKEN>'},
  body: fs.createReadStream('offline-bundle.tar.gz'),
  agent: new HttpsProxyAgent('http://127.0.0.1:3128')
});
```

anya (Security): Thanks. Quick security list: do not include private keys, recommend ephemeral upload tokens scoped to `bundle:upload`, and add a rotation note if bundles cross sites. I'll add a one-paragraph roles snippet.

leo (Support): Also call out cloud-init races where the proxy service isn't up before the installer runs. Suggest a systemd `ExecStartPre` loop to verify proxy responds on 3128 before proceeding. I can draft the ExecStartPre one-liner.

ci-bot: CI: docs build OK, linkcheck: warning on anchor /private/install/offline-proxy -> missing.

tara (Docs): Will change anchor to #offline-proxy-pattern and push the commit. Targeting final reviews this afternoon. Tagging @noah @juno @anya @leo for quick LGTM when updated. :thumbsup:
